# State Class View (variant): Forester (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Forester (`seed:R14-forester`, P2); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Prescribe and implement silvicultural treatments for stand objectives — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Inventory forest resources to stated precision with field plots and remote sensing — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Prepare and administer timber sale, stewardship and partner implementation agreements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Project stand development under alternative treatments with calibrated growth models — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess forest health and diagnose biotic and abiotic stressors — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Plan forest management and timber harvests to meet ecological and economic objectives — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
